# rms_tag (Resource)

Manages a Teltonika RMS Tag. Tags can be used to organize and filter devices.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rms_tag" "production" {
  name       = "Production"
  color      = "#00ff00"
  company_id = 12345
}

resource "rms_tag" "development" {
  name       = "Development"
  color      = "#ff0000"
  company_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `company_id` (Number) The company ID to assign the tag to.
- `name` (String) The name of the tag.

### Optional

- `color` (String) The color of the tag (hex code).

### Read-Only

- `device_count` (Number) The number of devices assigned to this tag.
- `id` (Number) The unique identifier for the tag.
